title: hubSessionMessages
responsibility: Formats and parses the Tracker notes that carry a Hub message, its delivery or refusal receipt and the session's keyed reply, and folds them into message threads.

inputs.name: hubMessageLine.text
inputs.description: Any text; control and line-separator characters become spaces.

inputs.name: hubMessageId.itemId
inputs.description: The ten-character Tracker item id the message thread lives on.

inputs.name: hubMessageId.uuid
inputs.description: A random UUID whose first eight hex digits make the message unique.

inputs.name: hubMessageItem.messageId
inputs.description: A Hub message id of the form <item id>-<8 hex>.

inputs.name: hubMessageTargetLabel.target
inputs.description: Chief of Staff, or one exact run named by its node and run id.

inputs.name: formatHubMessageNote.messageId
inputs.description: The id of the message being stored.

inputs.name: formatHubMessageNote.target
inputs.description: Who the message is for: Chief of Staff or one exact run.

inputs.name: formatHubMessageNote.text
inputs.description: Daniel's message text, flattened to one line.

inputs.name: formatHubDeliveredNote.messageId
inputs.description: The id of the message that reached its pane.

inputs.name: formatHubDeliveredNote.session
inputs.description: The tmux session the message was typed into and submitted.

inputs.name: formatHubRefusedNote.messageId
inputs.description: The id of the message that was not delivered.

inputs.name: formatHubRefusedNote.reason
inputs.description: Why it was not delivered, such as the run having ended or been replaced.

inputs.name: formatHubReplyNote.messageId
inputs.description: The id of the message being answered.

inputs.name: formatHubReplyNote.text
inputs.description: The session's reply text, flattened to one line.

inputs.name: hubPaneMessage.messageId
inputs.description: The id the session must quote when it replies.

inputs.name: hubPaneMessage.text
inputs.description: Daniel's message text.

inputs.name: parseHubMessageNote.text
inputs.description: The text of one Tracker note.

inputs.name: hubSessionMessages.notes
inputs.description: An item's notes, oldest first, with their times.

outputs.name: hubMessageIdPattern
outputs.description: Matches a Hub message id and captures its item id and hex tail.

outputs.name: hubMessageLine
outputs.description: The text as one trimmed line with single spaces.

outputs.name: hubMessageId
outputs.description: The message id, or null when the item id is not a Tracker item id.

outputs.name: hubMessageItem
outputs.description: The item id inside a message id, or null for any other text.

outputs.name: hubMessageTargetLabel
outputs.description: 'Chief of Staff' or 'run <node>#<run id>'.

outputs.name: formatHubMessageNote
outputs.description: The note text that stores a Hub message on its thread item.

outputs.name: formatHubDeliveredNote
outputs.description: The receipt note saying the message was submitted into that session's pane.

outputs.name: formatHubRefusedNote
outputs.description: The receipt note saying the message was not delivered and why.

outputs.name: formatHubReplyNote
outputs.description: The note that records the session's reply, keyed to the message id.

outputs.name: hubPaneMessage
outputs.description: One line typed into the pane, never starting with / or !, that ends with the exact tracker reply command.

outputs.name: parseHubMessageNote
outputs.description: The message, delivered, refused or reply event the note records, or null for any other note.

outputs.name: hubSessionMessages
outputs.description: Each Hub message once, with its status (stored, delivered, acknowledged or refused) and replies.
